photo.commonsTitle: File:Apartment building at 106 Ridge Street, Lower East Side, Manhattan - 20200906.jpg
photo.creator: Andre Carrotflower

notes: Position and heading: Commons {{Location}} geotag with compass heading (accuracy unknown).

The published file is a 2586x2586 square crop of a 4:3 iPhone frame, so the EXIF focal length (29 mm eq.) does not give the FOV directly: full-frame hfov would be 61.6°, a centred crop without rescaling 41.9°; 48° assumes a 3024-px square crop. Calibrate.
Pitch 20° estimated by eye from pedestrians' head height (≈ 91% of the image height).
Resected from 3 ground + 3 vertical-edge correspondences picked on the photo (data/calibration/nyc-ridge-street.json); rms 33.3 px. Geotag was 0.0 m away. No building height was used.

Hand-picked resection vs. the camera below: the maintainer resection above (position (-36.875, -33.871), heading 48.57°, pitch 17.07°, roll 1.34°, hfov 41.9°, all marked manual) is about 10° off in heading and 2° in roll. Its vertex-1 picks (data/calibration/nyc-ridge-street.json) mark the end of the ornate bays, not the end of the 28 m OSM edge, and are 433 px off under the camera below (docs/research/alignment.md §1).

Fixture camera auto-aligned from facade regularity (autoAlignCamera in web/src/lib/align.ts, with the resection relaxed from manual to inferred and hfov bounded to the EXIF range [41.9°, 61.6°]): heading 48.6° → 59.2°, roll 1.3° → -0.6°, moved 10.2 m along the Ridge Street facade and 0.7 m away from it; pitch 17.1° and hfov 41.9° (at the lower EXIF bound) kept. Window rows level to 0.11 m (robust σ; 0.80 m with the resection) and all 92 windows land on the target or 202 Rivington (88 with 4 missed with the resection). Values rounded; provenance inferred, so the app keeps refining it on load.

photo.creator: Julian Nyča
transformations: all EXIF/XMP metadata stripped (the original has no GPS and no ICC profile)

notes: Position: the uploader's Commons {{Location|43.856692|18.425885}}, which the Commons API lists as the camera location (type: camera). The camera itself recorded no GPS. The point lies on the south bank of the Miljacka, across the river from the building and 38.6 m from the facade line between the outer corners. The cross-check resection below puts the camera 44.7 m from that line, so from the geotag the facade projects about 19 % wider than photographed (outer corners at x ≈ 148 and 1978 px at street level, against ≈ 204 and ≈ 1745 px in the photo). The geotag is kept as published; docs/VALIDATION.md lists the effect on window placement.

Heading: neither Commons nor EXIF gives one. 338.3° is inferred as the reverse normal of the facade line between the building's outer corners (OSM nodes 2008185172 and 2008184871, bearing 68.3°), because the photo is square-on (cross-check below).

hfov 63.5° from EXIF FocalLength 18 mm on the Canon EOS 550D's 22.3 mm-wide APS-C sensor (manufacturer spec; ≈ 29 mm equivalent). EXIF has no 35 mm-equivalent field. The 3500x2333 file has the sensor's 3:2 aspect (native 5184x3456), so a plain downscale is assumed, not a crop. The EXIF FocalPlaneXResolution (5728 px/inch at 5184 px) would give a 23.0 mm width and hfov 65.1°, inside hfovRange.
Pitch 9° is a starting value (assumed), rounded from the cross-check resection (8.9°); the app re-solves it from the detected ground line on load.

Cross-check, not used as input: a least-squares resection with the camera model of scripts/solve_camera.py (hfov fixed at 63.5°, lens 1.6 m) from 4 correspondences picked on photo.jpg (±10–15 px): ground points at the facade base on the embankment-wall top, OSM node 2008185172 (west outer corner, way/190229391) at px (204, 993) and node 2008184871 (east outer corner, way/191316850) at px (1770, 967); vertical-edge points under the cornice at px (223, 400) and (1737, 400) (horizontal residual only, height free). Result: 43.85664389, 18.42592373, heading 339.36°, pitch 8.87°, roll 0.91°, RMS 6.8 px; 6.2 m from the geotag, 44.6 m from the facade and 0.6° off its normal. With a free hfov the 4 points are degenerate (6 equations), so hfov is held fixed.
Lens height 1.6 m above the riverside street (assumed).

subject.geocode: Commons description 'Obala Kulina bana No. 24'; no address is mapped on the building in OSM. OSM splits the facade into three building=apartments ways with no levels or height: way/190229391 (west wing, 16.4 m street edge), way/190229449 (centre, 7.1 m) and way/191316850 (east wing, 19.5 m). Target = the east wing (photo right), the longest edge with the most windows. The OSM centre way is narrower than the raised centre bay in the photo (≈ 13 m), so only the outer corners match the architecture.
